rubric: Evaluate the contract from the public request, issue-time owner decisions, and contemporaneous observable behavior. Require each obligation to state a supported, externally observable outcome—including explicit boundary decisions and preservation of compatible behavior—rather than merely posing an unresolved question. Treat code structure, algorithms, internal helpers, predicates broader than the supported case, representations, control flow, messages, documentation, fixtures, and test organization as incidental unless expressly required. Later patches and tests may diagnose causes, demonstrate outcomes, or provide non-regression evidence, but cannot retroactively require their implementation strategy, exact examples, private assertions, broadened inputs, or other hindsight-only choices. Penalize omitted supported outcomes, unsupported scope, and compatibility regressions; accept any implementation satisfying the evidence-backed observable contract.
